g.text: SDU | Null-competitive evidence within revisable windows
A learned zero-valued competitor lets a window contribute little evidence without forcing its remaining tokens to sum to one.
At fixed query/content, replicating a complete window leaves its aggregate unchanged; all affinities zero implies zero raw potential.
Null support and window discounts are learned aggregation coefficients, not calibrated association or reliability probabilities.
Null value and context are zero
A new window changes the interpretation of old tokens

text.tspan: Current drives every retained gate and signed value.

g.text: The full prefix potential is recomputed, never repeatedly added.
